name: tanner-hold
speaker: Tanner Pivotson
text: Please hold. Your break-in is important to us.

name: tanner-runway
speaker: Tanner Pivotson
text: I have eleven months of runway and a very large padlock.

name: tanner-private
speaker: Tanner Pivotson
text: Hey! You! This is a PRIVATE apocalypse. Members only.

name: hunter-market
speaker: HUNTER VALE
text: The world is ending. And I want to say, as a founder: that is a market.

name: hunter-gone
speaker: HUNTER VALE
text: One more thing. We're already gone.

name: vesper-live
speaker: Vesper Kade
text: Oh! A visitor. Hold on, I'm going live.

name: vesper-poll
speaker: Vesper Kade
text: I ran a poll. Should the camps get water. Eighty-eight percent said lol.

name: vesper-content
speaker: Vesper Kade
text: You're in the airlock. I can see you. Everyone can see you. Smile, you're content now.

name: ezra-walk
speaker: Ezra Seymour
text: Hello again. You came up the valley at a walk.

name: ezra-cameras
speaker: Ezra Seymour
text: There are eleven hundred cameras on this coast. Two of them are pointed at you now.

name: ezra-knocked
speaker: Ezra Seymour
text: You could have knocked.

name: prudence-road
speaker: Prudence Ashby
text: Please keep to the middle of the road. The edges are monitored.

name: prudence-turrets
speaker: Prudence Ashby
text: The turrets aren't cruel. They're cautious.

name: sentinel-apology
speaker: Careful Sentinel
text: Apologies in advance. You're in a protected area.

name: sentinel-sorry
speaker: Careful Sentinel
text: I'm so sorry. I've been asked to stop you here.

name: beta-early
speaker: HUNTER (beta)
text: Hey! Welcome to the Dome. You're early. Everybody's early.

name: beta-ship
speaker: HUNTER (beta)
text: Every day we ship. Some days we ship twice. That's the culture.

name: beta-fix
speaker: HUNTER (beta)
text: We already shipped a fix for your favourite trick.

name: helper-lost
speaker: Ascend Helper
text: Hi there! You look lost. Let me help.

name: orrin-customer
speaker: Orrin Sayle
text: Hello! Welcome to the Cathedral. You're a customer now.

name: orrin-drones
speaker: Orrin Sayle
text: The drones aren't armed. They're just very good at their jobs.

name: drone-hold
speaker: Dropt drone
text: Address confirmed. Please hold still for delivery.

name: drone-returned
speaker: Dropt drone
text: Returned to sender. Thank you for choosing Dropt.

name: kit-queue
speaker: Kit Szabo
text: You're in the queue. Everyone is in the queue.

name: kit-moat
speaker: Kit Szabo
text: The moat is minus forty degrees. Please don't test that. People test that.

name: kit-bridge
speaker: Kit Szabo
text: Somebody lowered my bridge. That's an unauthorised allocation of bridge.

name: agnes-heavy
speaker: Agnes Price
text: It isn't locked. It never was. It's just heavy.

name: agnes-weak
speaker: Agnes Price
text: Every door has a weak point. The job is getting the client to sign for it.

name: seedbot-firmware
speaker: SeedBot
text: FIRMWARE REVIEW IN PROGRESS. PLEASE DO NOT STEAL ANYTHING DURING THIS TIME.

name: kade-asset
speaker: Kade Recovery
text: Asset located. Initiating recovery.

name: kade-waiver
speaker: Kade Recovery
text: Contact! Somebody get the waiver!

name: kade-fire
speaker: Kade Recovery
text: Fire in the hole! Sign the release!

name: kade-equity
speaker: Kade Recovery
text: Don't shoot! My equity hasn't vested!

name: kade-review
speaker: Kade Recovery
text: Come out and nobody gets a performance review.

name: mara-together
speaker: Mara Voss
text: When we go west, we go together.
